text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And it's Mejiro McQueen! Mejiro
McQueen has
won!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
McQueen has brought the coveted
plaque home
to the Mejiro family! She
wasn't about to lose this
one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! I have worked so
hard in
preparation for this day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Having now fulfilled my duty, I am
overjoyed. I
have achieved my dream!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Forgetting to even clap, Mejiro Palmer
watches Mejiro McQueen give her
dignified victory speech
in a wordless
daze.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh. Trainer... Sorry...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: McQueen was great, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right? More than that, though, I'm
impressed
with her attitude.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was an undisputed victory.
Yeah, that was an indisputable vic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
She's taken the weight of all the
pressure she was
born under and made it
her actual dream...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
She just kept moving forward. That's
just...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer swallows the rest of her
words, and
a gloomy look comes over
her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Palmster? C'mon,
cheer up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But Mejiro Palmer doesn't manage to
crack a
smile for the rest of the evening.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I feel so small and so... insignificant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer looks up at the ceiling
and lets out
a soft sigh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna be tied down by the
Mejiro name,
so I thought I'd show more
of my real self...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But when I saw how serious McQueen
was, I didn't
know what else there even
was to run for besides
the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I figured I'd run for my own freedom,
but... what's that freedom even for? For
sating my own selfish
desires? Or is it for
something else?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what it is, but is that reasoning
something I can really be proud of in
front of McQueen? Can
it even be
compared to her own determination?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because it was the spring Tenno Sho, which is just so important to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But I wanna get back to my real self,
even just a
little... So for my next race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She trails off gloomily. A festival race
might the
best thing to pick her mood
up. In which case...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's enter the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios blurts out the race name,

sounding energetic yet mournful.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be, like, so fire to run
together?! It'll be like this never
happened. We can just bring
the vibes,
bestie-style!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Plus,
it's a festival race! Everyone's there
to get pumped and have a good time
anyway! So, like,
you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... The Takarazuka Kinen could be
good...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gives a slight nod. But...
choice_data_list: Sounds good. Let's go with that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the Takarazuka Kinen, we need
to take
another look at what racing
means to Mejiro
Palmer.
